SAL - a great place to research. 1 Master Thesis - Quantum Magnetometry (all genders) // Job-ID: 210-0 

Praktikum/Werkstudium, Vollzeit · VILLACH

Your future responsibilities

Are you fascinated by quantum technologies and eager to contribute to cutting-edge research?

Bringing together applied science and industry, Silicon Austria Labs (SAL) conducts cutting-edge research in Sensor Systems, Microsystems, Intelligent Wireless Systems, Power Electronics, and Embedded Systems. As part of our Photonic Systems research unit, the Applied Quantum Sensing Team is looking for a motivated Master's student for an exciting Master Thesis focusing on quantum magnetometry.

Your future tasks include:

 * Experimental work in the Applied Quantum Sensing team

 * Design, assemble and test novel quantum magnetometers based on solid-state spins in wide-band gap semiconductors 

 * Develop novel quantum control protocols

 * Implement software and hardware solutions

Your profile

 * Enrolled master student (university in EU) in a related, technical field

 * Solid academic background in quantum technologies, solid-state physics, optics, or spectroscopy.

 * A passion for physics and a curious, open mindset.

 * Enthusiasm for Python programming and fast-paced lab work.

 * Motivation to tackle challenges and contribute ideas within an interdisciplinary team.

 * Excellent English communication skills (German is a plus). 

Important Facts about SAL

 * Duration: 6 months

 * Diversified research activities with plenty of technical challenges. 

 * State-of-the-art lab facilities and instruments. 

 * Internal and external training opportunities for further development.

 * € 4 per day food allowance in restaurants or € 2 per day in supermarkets. 

 * Family & kids friendly. 

 * Free coffee/milk/tea & fresh fruits. 

 * Our values: 

 ** Open door policy, flexibility in working hours, casual dress code, diverse teams, working with people of different nationalities, informal communication, lifelong learning,compatibility of family and career, sustainability, personal growth, and collective advancement. 

This position is subject to the Collective Agreement for employees in non-university research (Research CA). For this position, we offer a monthly gross salary of EUR 1.929, paid 14 times a year.

As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomicprecision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial roleour customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductorbreakthroughs.

What you'll do
 * Conduct process engineering research, development, and evaluation in support of Lam's cutting-edge semiconductor equipment and systems
 * Review and enhance processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture and fabrication of products
 * Develop and sustain new processes and process improvements to reduce production costs and increase yields
 * Compile and analyze test data to establish next steps in process development and determine appropriate limits and variables for process specifications
 * Collaborate internally to plan, collect data, analyze results, and report on customer demos for existing process applications
 * Contribute to next generation product development and release activities supporting the semiconductor roadmap
 * Provide leadership, clear direction, and guidance to process technicians to support execution activities

Who we're looking for
Minimum Qualifications:

 * Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics or related field with 3+ years of experience; or a PhD with no previous professionalexperience; or equivalent experience in electrochemical metal surface deposition and/ormodification

 * Structured and organized working style
 * Ability to work independently, high degree of flexibility and capable to work in a crossfunctional environmentns

Preferred Qualifications:

 * Familiarity with working in a laboratory and on semiconductor equipment with experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques
 * In-depth understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and/or Design of Experiments (DOE)
 * Highly proficient in MATLAB, Python, or other similar scientific computing language
 * Working knowledge of statistical analysis and problem-solving methodologies
 * Experience with statistical tools (JMP, Minitab, etc.)
 * Background in Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD), Plasma Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition (PECVD), or Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD)
 * Background in Plasma Physics, Reactive Ion Etching (RIE), Atomic Layer Etching (ALE), Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP), Capacitively Coupled Plasma (CCP)

 * Experience working in a collaborative and matrixed environment with diverse teams, semiconductor customers, and/or partners

jobs.occupation: Scientist (f/m/d) for Designing, Testing and Qualifying Next Generation Aeronautical Batteries
jobs.description:
1 Scientist (f/m/d) for Designing, Testing and Qualifying Next Generation Aeronautical Batteries  * You will support the development of next generation batteries for aeronautical applications, from cell selection, module and pack design, prototype assembly, testing and qualification.
 * Depending on your background, you will develop and test:
(a) physics-based AI/ML methods for aeronautical battery design and validation,
(b) numerical methods for battery state and safety prediction, and
(c) high-voltage/high-power or lightweight battery prototypes, including structural and multifunctional energy storage systems.
 * You will interface with experienced scientists and engineers in the field of aerospace across Europe.

 * You will work closely with European Institutions and international partners from research organisations and industry on multi-annual large-scale collaborative projects.
 * You will build your own network, contribute to defining our strategic research direction, and prepare proposals for new projects with the support of your colleagues .
 * You will publish your results in high-ranking journals and will support other scientists in doing so.
 * You will supervise PhD and master's students.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: 

 * PhD-level qualification in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a closely related discipline, with a focus on battery design and testing, preferably for high-voltage/high-power aerospace applications.
 * Alternatively, an MSc-level qualification combined with relevant professional experience may be accepted.

 * A traceable scientific publication record is an essential requirement. Experience publishing in high-ranking peer-reviewed journals is required.
 * Proven experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) physics-based AI/ML methods in engineering, (ii) high-voltage/high-power electrical design and testing, (iii) lightweight structural design and testing, or (iv) hybrid-/more-electric systems and aircraft architecture. The cover letter must explain the candidate's fit with at least one profile (i-iv) and support the claimed expertise with relevant publications and project experience. Missing information may result in rejection.

 * Programming skills in Python, MATLAB, including Simulink, C/C++, or similar languages are required.
 * Knowledge of the fundamentals of battery electrochemistry and understanding of battery modelling methodologies are highly valued.
 * Experience with state-of-the-art simulation tools (such as ANSYS, Modelica, or Dymola) are highly valued.
 * Experience in battery testing at cell, module, and pack level is considered an advantage.
 * Experience in industrial projects and/or European research programmes, such as Horizon Europe or Clean Aviation, including an understanding of the European aerospace research ecosystem, is an asset.
 * A high level of motivation to pursue a scientific or research-oriented career is required. Strong self-motivation and personal drive are essential.
 * English knowledge appropriate to the job. Knowledge of German is desirable.

 

What to expect: 

 * Employee benefits include a canteen allowance, health care support, pension fund, family benefits, additional leave, vouchers, sports and social events, flexible working hours with up to 50% home office, conference support, and individual training and career development opportunities.
 * Starting date is expected in Q4-2026/Q1-2027 (flexible). Applications will be accepted until September 30th, 2026, at 12:00 (CET). Early-bird applications are welcome since the selection process can start at an earlier stage.

 

AIT promotes an inclusive and family-friendly workplace with equal opportunities and diversity. We particularly welcome applications from female candidates.

jobs.occupation: Master Thesis "Characterizing features of Driving Dynamics on a Motorcycle Probe Vehicle"
jobs.description:
As Austria's largest research and technology organisation for applied research, we are dedicated to make substantial contributions to solving the major challenges of our time, climate change and digitalisation. To achieve our goals, we rely on our specific research, development and technology competencies, which are the basis of our commitment to excellence in all areas. With our open culture of innovation and our motivated, international teams, we are working to position AIT as Austria's leading research institution at the highest international level and to make a positive contribution to the economy and society.

The Center for Innovation Systems & Policy is looking for new Ingenious Partners for our location in Vienna. Our Center for Innovation Systems & Policy is a think tank in national and international research and innovation networks, and it is a key partner for public administration, companies, universities, and research institutions.

The Competence Unit Transformation Govern... 1 Master Thesis "Characterizing features of Driving Dynamics on a Motorcycle Probe Vehicle"  * For this master's thesis you will investigate extensive time series of driving dynamics obtained from multiple motorcycle rides by multiple riders on given tracks.
 * You will support us in working out characteristic features in driving dynamics that differentiate the different riders.
 * You will investigate the possibility of using simulation software (like IPG Motorcycle maker) to use the obtained data for setting up simulations of motorcycle movements.

 * Under the guidance of our researchers, you will implement model building approaches to extract characterizing features from motorcyclist data.
 * With the support of our team, you will investigate the feasibility of simulating driver movements based on the characterizing features extracted before.
 * You will explore different model-building approaches and criteria for selecting the most appropriate one with the guidance of our researchers.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:

 * Ongoing master's studies in the field of Technical Mathematics at TU Vienna
 * Good knowledge in R, Python, or MATLAB, willingness to adopt multiple of these languages as needed
 * Enjoyment of application-oriented questions of industry
 * High level of commitment and team spirit
 * English or German skills commensurate with the role - The thesis can be completed in either language

 

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: as soon as possible, with some flexibility depending on your availability
 * EUR 1273 gross per month for 20 hours/week based on the collective agreement.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

 

 

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.
